android-content|Label.summary: A Plenix role on Android is a small read-only label in the tag look: the role’s icon and its name (Owner, Editor, Viewer, or a custom role’s own name) on the neutral fill with a hairline border and 4 dp corners, or a custom role’s category color. It is a label, not a chip: it takes no touch and no focus; the control that changes the role is a menu beside it. A role is never drawn in a status color.
